name: Colorado
badge: Colorado · All 64 Counties · No Upfront Cost
intro: Courts, county clerks, and state agencies in Colorado are holding funds belonging to former property owners and residents. RCG monitors all 64 Colorado counties and recovers these funds at no upfront cost.

body.title: Recovery in Colorado. All 64 Counties.
paragraphs: Colorado foreclosure surplus funds are held by the county public trustee after a trustee sale. El Paso, Arapahoe, Jefferson, Denver, and Weld counties generate the highest volume of surplus cases in the state.

The Colorado Department of Treasury Unclaimed Property Division holds funds from dormant accounts, uncashed checks, life insurance proceeds, and other assets belonging to Colorado residents. RCG searches Colorado public trustee records and state unclaimed property databases for every Colorado client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Colorado. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.

lists.title: All 64 Colorado Counties.
lists.intro: RCG monitors foreclosure surplus funds, tax sale overages, and unclaimed property across every county in Colorado. If funds exist in your name in any Colorado county, we will find them and recover them.

footerLine: Foreclosure surplus funds · Public trustee sale overages · Colorado unclaimed property · Estate and heir recovery · Excess proceeds from court sales, available across all 64 Colorado counties.
ctaTitle: Find Out What Colorado Is Holding in Your Name.
ctaText: We search Colorado court records and state unclaimed property databases at no cost. If funds exist, we file the claim and recover them on a pure contingency basis.
